rationale: Despite the broader market plunging further since entry (SPY moving from -0.57% to -1.36% and VIXY from +3.97% to +8.09%), UGI has shown unexpected relative strength by grinding higher above its 5-minute 9-EMA ($35.03) and trading near its maximum adverse excursion at $35.16. Because the expected downside follow-through failed to materialize after 32 minutes even with heavy macro tailwinds, the downside momentum thesis has broken down, warranting an immediate exit ahead of the $35.33 invalidation level to preserve the remaining daily loss budget.
